title: Segfault while handling pgbench workload
body:
The PgBench tool has 2 modes: Initialize (delete old table, create new tables, add rows) and benchmark (core functionality).   I've been running pgbench in the Initialize state in a loop and caught a DROP TABLES crash.  You should be able to reproduce this with master, but it takes a handful of back-to-back runs:

> 17:51 $ time ./build/latest/postgres/bin/pgbench -i -s 10 postgres
> dropping old tables...
> creating tables (with primary keys)...
> generating data...
> 100000 of 1000000 tuples (10%) done (elapsed 1.71 s, remaining 15.35 s)

> 300000 of 1000000 tuples (30%) done (elapsed 8.49 s, remaining 19.81 s)
> 400000 of 1000000 tuples (40%) done (elapsed 11.59 s, remaining 17.38 s)
> 500000 of 1000000 tuples (50%) done (elapsed 15.22 s, remaining 15.22 s)
> 600000 of 1000000 tuples (60%) done (elapsed 18.37 s, remaining 12.25 s)
> 700000 of 1000000 tuples (70%) done (elapsed 21.99 s, remaining 9.42 s)
> 800000 of 1000000 tuples (80%) done (elapsed 25.08 s, remaining 6.27 s)
> 900000 of 1000000 tuples (90%) done (elapsed 28.73 s, remaining 3.19 s)
> 1000000 of 1000000 tuples (100%) done (elapsed 32.23 s, remaining 0.00 s)
> done.

> user	0m0.182s
> sys	0m0.013s
> Nicolass-MacBook-Pro.local:~/code/yugabyte-db [pgbench_alter L|…6]
> 17:53 $ time ./build/latest/postgres/bin/pgbench -i -s 10 postgres
> dropping old tables...
> FATAL:  terminating connection due to unexpected postmaster exit
> ERROR:  Timed out: Timed out waiting for Table Deletion
> 
> real	1m1.750s
> user	0m0.002s
